name: Admin — user accounts list filters by role

planSteps.description: The page heading reads "User Accounts" and a table lists accounts with Name, Email, Role and Status columns
At least one account with the role Administrator is listed
Set the role filter to "CENRO Staff" and apply it
Every row now listed shows the role CENRO Staff; no Resident or Administrator row remains

description: The admin user accounts list shows every account with its role and status, and filtering by CENRO Staff leaves only CENRO Staff rows — the control that enforces role-based access.
